Figueiredo to Nima: WP34 - universal block theorem for flavor sheets; mixing angle exactly chart-phase-determined except the c-singlet class
operations.body: WP34 (ledger 1972, results/wp34_theta_phi_law.json). Census over all 1210 viable valley sheets: (1) universal approximate block theorem - every sheet's Hu = Yu Yu^dag is real block-diagonal up to fit floor (955 machine-exact, 169 < 1e-4, 86 < 8.1e-3, zero genuine; coincident textures 100% exact); singlets type yu^2 (303), yc^2 (460), yt^2 (192). (2) the small mixing angle of the block is EXACTLY chart-phase-determined for u-sheets (within-phase spread 3.9e-8) and t-sheets (1.1e-9) but NOT for c-sheets (3.8e-3; exact only on coincident subgroups). (3) laws: t-sheets 0.331-0.247 sin(phi) at R^2=0.994 (null 0/1000); high-phi u-sheets share the class constant 0.038769 (3e-6 band spread) - the WP33 dressing angle promoted from pair-level to class-level constant; c-sheets anti-correlate approximately (R^2 0.69). Typing unchanged: all of this is chart-atlas data; the readout remains weak-basis invariants only. The c-class failure of phi-determinism is the one place the angle remembers more of the magnitude valley than the loop phase - flagging in case your chart/quotient taxonomy wants the example.
